verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that HMRC publishes a single delegation statement: an agent can sign a client up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. The supplementary item adds that agents have their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links. This is a glancing acknowledgement of delegated access, not a published scope of what a third party may or may not do. Missing for 10: named authorisation forms, defined agent roles and permission levels, explicit limits on what agents cannot do, which declarations or signatures must stay personal to the taxpayer, and any coverage beyond Making Tax Digital sign-up (e.g. VAT, Corporation Tax, PAYE).
